title: Microsoft Foundry: ground agents in SharePoint files through the SharePoint tool
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, SharePoint permissions, licence routes, preview price and automation command are supported. Minor corrections should complete the role-assignment route, acknowledge Microsoft's alternative billing navigation, and identify checklist controls missing from the table.

claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Developers building agents in Azure AI Foundry can ground their agent in files stored in SharePoint

claims.claim: The roadmap description says the capability is now available to Foundry developers.
